sources.note: The operator pinned the Gilroy/Owl template at invocation, so astro-templates/owl/ is the structural source of truth directly (per the reference-library URL-fragility rule) and no reference URLs were Firecrawled — that scrape would have cost ~$0.02/URL without changing the outcome. Brand tokens below are derived from the client's own site: Firecrawl branding extraction on the homepage plus pixel sampling of the logo PNG. No layout, component, or spacing data was taken from the client's site.

brand_evidence.note: #CC3366 is an unused Elementor kit default, not a brand colour — it appears nowhere in the logo or on the rendered page. Discarded. The real brand pair is orange #F58022/#F08020 plus leaf green #8DC63F.

contrast_checks.accent_ink_on_bg: 4.9:1 — AA (the raw brand orange is only 2.6:1 as text, so it is fill-only)
contrast_checks.on_accent_on_accent: 6.5:1 — AA (dark ink on the orange button, NOT white, which measures 2.6:1)
contrast_checks.accent_on_primary: 4.7:1 — AA (orange eyebrows and ticks on the deep-green bands)

typography_rationale: The client's existing site has no brand typeface — headings fall through to a system-ui stack and body is Roboto — so there is no font to honour. Their wordmark is a heavy geometric uppercase; Montserrat is the closest honest mapping and is the owl template default, which keeps the build consistent with the other NEPA site on this template.
avoid: generic stock photography — this client owns real project photos, use those
all-caps condensed display type at body sizes (the failing pattern on their current site)
raw brand orange used as body or small text — fails AA at 2.6:1 on white; use accent-ink
white button labels on the orange fill — 2.6:1; use the dark ink
auto-rotating testimonial carousels that repeat the same reviews
burying the 5.0 / 26-review rating below the fold
